window_base_and_scaling_scope.window_base_generality: All finite-set arithmetic identities (paired-station partition, odd prime-power vanishing above T/2, square-lift parity, pointwise telescoping of s_Y(n), sum_{e|n} |w_2(e)| = (log n)^2, large-prime station disjointness) are window-independent; the fringe feature norm bound ||G_{Phi_2}||_{Y, w_0}^2 <= (8192*w_0^5*log w_0)/(log Y)^2 + (324*w_0^5*log w_0)/Y^(5/4) is formally proved in Lean for every fixed real window base w_0 > 1 (paramWindowNormSq Y w_0) and specialized to w_0 = tau, while the uniform O(1) scalar fringe bound ||Phi_{fringe,Y}^{scal}||_Y^2 <= C_fr is formalized strictly on the canonical w_0 = tau window (windowEnergyNormSq Y; no general-base constant formula is asserted for the scalar fringe bound). Both bounds are norm/squared-norm bounds on fringe terms; squared-energy comparisons also retain mixed inner-product terms 2*Re<F, R>. No result in TASK-TC-065/TC-065R relies on any tau-specific transcendence property.
window_base_and_scaling_scope.e2_cutoff_specification_note: Route 6 E2 is implemented on the exact prime-power partition p^k > floor(sqrt(T)) vs p^k <= floor(sqrt(T)) matching Lean splitFeatureHighV / splitFeatureLowV (exact channel orthogonality <V_gt, V_le>_Y = 0). Pairwise station disjointness (Theorem 4 Part 4b) holds for distinct primes p_1 != p_2 > floor(sqrt(T)), whereas same-prime higher powers p^k, p^(k+1) > floor(sqrt(T)) share multiples. The frozen protocol file is preserved byte-for-byte unchanged. As certified finite observations, prime-power T_main^{(E2)} is strictly positive on seen Y in {64, 128, 256, 512}, unseen Y in {100, 300, 600, 1200, 1600, 1800}, and intervals [101.60, 102.45] and [1558.50, 1558.60] (non-monotone across the combined set: +0.1471 at Y = 256 vs +0.1368 at Y = 300; no asymptotic growth or monotonicity is inferred from samples); strict-prime p > floor(sqrt(T)) was spot-checked strictly positive at sample scales {EXP3-LEFT, 64, 100, 128}.
